name: Dense Copy Extraction
definition: Extracts a region defined by a bounding box into a dense 3D array, filled with the grid's background value, then overwritten with `get_value` for every coordinate in the box.
summary: Dense Copy Extraction converts sparse grid data into a contiguous dense 3D array via bulk conversion, distinguishing itself from point-query methods by initializing with a background value and overwriting it with interpolated data.
